notes.title: Hell Architect Prologue: update 1.02
notes.notes:
Hello Sinners!


We are happy to inform you that we have just made a hellish new UPDATE! 🔥🔥🔥



A new language especially for our sinners!

😈😈😈😈😈😈😈😈😈😈😈😈


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38893617/a6fb2e85b9d43df5a517a5bd632e56561165dab9.png

What has changed?

ADDED:

 Brazilian Portuguese language
 Confirmation of game closure
 Confirmation of exit to menu
 Information about the game version in the menu
 Hints on the loading screen (ENG and PL)


CHANGE: 

 Now you can continue to the game after it loads by pressing any key instead of only spacebar


FIXED: 

 Priorities visible after deleting a building




Wish you a lot of fun! 😈

Hellish regards, 
Woodland Games

notes.title: Hell Architect Prologue: Update 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello Sinners!


We are happy to inform that we make first update for Hell Architect Prologue 😈😈😈 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38893617/021419178126205494979ee74ed7a86608d593e8.png

What's change?

ADDED: 

 option to torture/put to work sinners with low needs levels
 sims will now leave a structure to complete other tasks when no resources for that structure's process are available
 a button displaying the full game version's features
 removed loss of the type of need a sim is working on at the moment
 possibility to place sinner in a structure with no resources



FIX: 

 sound looping after a sinner's death
 sinners blocked in a structure when no path is available
 default volume of some of the annoying sinners' screams lowered
 volume adjustment not affecting the Prologue intro
 no new construction possible in place of a previously deconstructed structure
 dig and build tasks cancelling on their own
 issues when returning to the Main Menu after completing the Tutorial (unresponsive buttons)
 text localization missing for resources when building a structure
 improved efficiency when choosing sims for tasks (now prioritizes the closest sims)
 deselecting sims from structures (when working outside a structure)



Wish a lot of fun and hellish regards, 
Woodland Games Team 😈

notes.title: Hell Architect, Prologue release date!
